name: minimal-round-trip
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.27 (a CRC-32 checksum on the tlv wire) with Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): Key, set length 0x10, item 2 (time_ms 1614456000000 as 8 bytes 00000177e5138e00), then the checksum item 01 04 16b0fb85 last; every other key absent writes no item, so the round trip is exact. CRC-32 of ISO/IEC 13818-1 (poly 04c11db7, init ffffffff, MSB first, no reflection, no final XOR) over the key through the checksum item's tag and length (ruling 1 of 0.27). Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program, checked against the check values 123456789 -> 0376e6e7 and empty -> ffffffff.
